author: Dyspa
body:
Going through the teams participating in the tourney, I found out this one guy with this name that sounded familiar to me. If you go to Google Translate and type "salta muros", something similar to "wall jumper" will pop-up. If you make a relation (About this term) with mexican people for example, this would count as a racial term which is not allowed right? (Mexican crossing/jumping the border).
I feel offended with this even though I'm not mexican since this guy is somewhat being racist with the whole spanish community.
I'll be waiting for a response. Hope you find an appropiate punishment for him.
Regards, Juano.

title: Salta_Muros: Inappropiate Name

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hi Juanoh.

Unfortunately, the name you have given us cannot be considered inappropriate.

The name itself does not directly offend anyone, as the term "wall jumper" can have several other meanings. From the viewpoint of both myself and other staff members, we can most likely conclude that the person who created this name did not mean any racial offence whatsoever.

If you have some evidence of him insulting the Mexican community or if the name bothers you extremely, don't hesitate to contact a staff member via Skype.

Thanks.
Midnite
